Claude Entity Analyst

Ask Claude what a page is about — entities stated or implied, relationships, attribute gaps, the real subject and naming problems — in one fixed shape, then check every answer against the page text.

What you need
An Anthropic API key
Cost
About a cent or two per page with Claude Sonnet 5.5; less with Haiku 4.5
Feed it
Paste one page's main content, or upload a crawl export with a URL column and a content column. Optional: the Entity Extractor's entity_mentions.csv
You get back
Entities with confidence tiers, relationships, attribute gaps and naming issues, as CSV and JSON

How to use it

  1. Paste your Anthropic key. It stays in this tab and is sent only to Anthropic.
  2. Choose an analysis: entity map, attribute gaps, subject check, or naming and ambiguity.
  3. Paste one page's main content (or upload your crawl CSV) and set the intended entity.
  4. Check the price estimate, then run it. Start with one page before a whole crawl.
  5. Read the tiers: use Solid and Likely rows, review Candidates, never use Discards. Export the CSVs.

Worth knowing. An LLM can name entities that are not on the page. Every quote is checked against your text automatically — that check is the point of the tool, so never skip the tier column.

Add your key and some content.
An LLM can name entities that are not on the page. Every result below is checked against the page text automatically and given a confidence tier. Use Solid and Likely rows; review Candidates; never use Discards.

Results

Tiers: Solid on the page and confirmed by the NLP API · Likely on the page, quote verified · Candidate implied, evidence verified — review · Discard the quote is not on the page.

What this can and cannot tell you

  • It is an analyst, not a measurement. Google's NLP API gives salience scores you can re-run; Claude gives judgement — implied entities, relationships, missing attributes. Use both: the Entity Extractor for the numbers, this for what extraction cannot see.
  • Answers vary between runs and models. The fixed output shape makes them comparable, not identical. Record the model and date with any finding.
  • Missing attributes are suggestions. They come from the model's general knowledge of what readers expect — check them against your gap matrix and real queries before you brief anyone.
  • Long pages are trimmed to the first 30,000 characters. Feed it the main content, not the whole HTML.
  • Your content goes to Anthropic. Check your client agreement before you paste client pages. Nothing is sent to MLforSEO.
